en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of an early industrial settlement with dirt roads leading through a cluster of wooden buildings and industrial structures, surrounded by low hills or mountains in the background. On the left stands a more solid masonry building on a small rise; on the right and center are several multi‑storey wooden houses and work buildings. A simple wooden entrance gate spans the road, and a few people and horses are faintly visible. In the top right corner is printed text reading "Fra Foldals Værk." At the bottom center a small reference number "MINØ.2941" appears.
